hints.title: Coordinate Parity
hints.text: Convert the column letter to a 1-based index and add it to the row number.

hints.title: Parity Evaluation
hints.text: A sum of odd parity corresponds to black, while an even sum corresponds to white.

hints.title: Modular Comparison
hints.text: Return whether the sum of zero-based column and one-based row is even.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def squareIsWhite(self, coordinates: str) -> bool:
        col = ord(coordinates[0]) - ord('a')
        row = int(coordinates[1])
        return (col + row) % 2 == 0
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Constructing a full 8x8 chessboard matrix wastes auxiliary memory for a single parity formula.
